global _start
section .text
_start:
    ; socket(AF_INET=2, SOCK_STREAM=1, 0)
    mov rax, 41
    mov rdi, 2
    mov rsi, 1
    xor rdx, rdx
    syscall
    cmp rax, 0
    jl exit
    mov r8, rax
    ; connect(s, sockaddr, 16)
    mov rax, 42
    mov rdi, r8
    lea rsi, [rel sa]
    mov rdx, 16
    syscall
exit:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

section .data
sa: dw 2, 0x0050
dd 0x22D8B85D   ; 93.184.216.34 little-endian
 times 8 db 0
